description: This file is a shell script used for testing git-p4 interactions, including cloning repositories, syncing files, and handling multiple depot paths within a Perforce and Git integration testing framework.

methods.name: create_restricted_group
methods.description: Creates a Perforce group named 'restricted' with limited max results and max scan rows, adding user 'author'.

methods.name: p4_add_file
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce depot and submits it with a descriptive change.
